subScenes.name: 询问票价
subScenes.description: 游客询问景点门票价格及成人/儿童差异。

followUps.text: It's $15 for adults and $8 for children.
followUps.text_cn: 成人15美元，儿童8美元。

followUps.text: We have a discount today — only $10 for everyone.
followUps.text_cn: 今天有优惠，每人只要10美元。

followUps.text: The price depends on the time slot — morning tickets are $12, afternoon are $18.
followUps.text_cn: 价格根据时段不同：上午票12美元，下午票18美元。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于初次询问基础票价，适用于博物馆、景点、剧院等场景

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any student discounts?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 学生询问是否有优惠票价

followUps.text: Yes, with a valid student ID, it's $10 instead of $15.
followUps.text_cn: 有，出示有效学生证可享10美元优惠价（原价15美元）。

followUps.text: Sorry, we don't offer student discounts — only senior and group rates.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我们不提供学生优惠，只对老年人和团体有折扣。

followUps.text: We do, but you need to book online in advance — the discount won't apply at the counter.
followUps.text_cn: 有，但必须提前在线预订，现场购票不享受优惠。

qaPairs.usageNote: 学生群体高频提问，回应需体现政策差异与操作条件

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the ticket price per person or for the whole group?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 票价是按人算还是按团体算？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 团体游客确认计价方式

followUps.text: It's per person — each ticket is $12.
followUps.text_cn: 按人计算，每张票12美元。

followUps.text: For groups of 5 or more, we offer a flat rate of $50 total.
followUps.text_cn: 5人及以上团体，统一收费50美元。

followUps.text: It's per person, but if you buy 3 or more tickets, you get one free.
followUps.text_cn: 按人计价，但买3张送1张。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于家庭或团体游客，澄清计价逻辑避免误解

subScenes.name: 咨询优惠
subScenes.description: 游客询问学生、老人或团体是否有折扣。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any discounts for students or groups?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有学生或团体优惠吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 游客咨询门票是否有学生或团体优惠

followUps.text: Yes, we offer a 30% discount with a valid student ID.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，凭有效学生证可享30%折扣。

followUps.text: Groups of 10 or more get a 20% discount — would you like to book as a group?
followUps.text_cn: 10人以上团体可享20%折扣，您要以团体方式预订吗？

followUps.text: I'm sorry, we don't have any current discounts, but tickets are already at our lowest seasonal rate.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，目前没有优惠，但票价已是当季最低价了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于游客主动询问优惠信息的场景，服务员需根据政策提供明确回应

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a special offer if I buy tickets online?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 如果我在线购票有特别优惠吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问线上购票是否有额外优惠

followUps.text: Yes, online bookings get a 15% discount and skip the ticket line!
followUps.text_cn: 有的，在线购票享15%折扣，并可免排队。

followUps.text: We don't offer discounts online, but you can reserve tickets in advance to guarantee entry.
followUps.text_cn: 线上购票没有折扣，但可以提前预订确保入场。

followUps.text: Actually, we have a flash sale this week — online tickets are 25% off until Friday!
followUps.text_cn: 其实本周有限时促销——在线购票周五前享25%折扣！

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客关心线上购票优势，服务员需说明是否优惠、是否节省时间或是否有促销

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I get a discount if I buy multiple tickets at once?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 如果我一次性买多张票能打折吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问批量购票是否有优惠

followUps.text: Absolutely! Buy 3 or more tickets and get the 4th one free.
followUps.text_cn: 当然！买3张送1张。

followUps.text: We don't have a bulk discount, but you can combine it with a membership for savings.
followUps.text_cn: 没有批量折扣，但您可以结合会员资格享受优惠。

followUps.text: It depends on the event — for this exhibition, no bulk discount applies, but we can hold tickets for you.
followUps.text_cn: 这取决于活动——本次展览不支持批量折扣，但我们可以为您保留门票。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客试探批量购买优惠，服务员需根据政策灵活回应，避免简单拒绝

subScenes.name: 确认开放时间
subScenes.description: 游客确认景点当日开放和关闭时间。

qaPairs.triggerText: What time do you open/close today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们今天几点开门/关门？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 游客询问景点/博物馆/剧院当天的开放时间

followUps.text: We open at 9 AM and close at 6 PM today.
followUps.text_cn: 我们今天早上9点开门，晚上6点关门。

followUps.text: We’re closing early today at 4 PM due to a private event.
followUps.text_cn: 今天因为私人活动，我们下午4点就关门了。

followUps.text: Sorry, we’re closed today for maintenance. We reopen tomorrow at 9 AM.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，今天因维护闭馆，明天早上9点重新开放。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于游客在到达前确认开放时间，避免白跑一趟。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is the ticket office still open?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 游客接近闭馆时间，担心错过购票机会

followUps.text: Yes, we’re open until 30 minutes after closing time for last-minute tickets.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我们在闭馆后30分钟内仍出售最后一刻的门票。

followUps.text: No, the ticket office closed 10 minutes ago. You’ll need to buy online.
followUps.text_cn: 不，售票处10分钟前就关闭了，您需要在线购买。

followUps.text: We’re closed, but you can still enter if you have a pre-booked e-ticket.
followUps.text_cn: 售票处已关闭，但如果您有预订的电子票，仍可入场。

qaPairs.usageNote: 帮助学习者在临近闭馆时判断是否还能购票或入场。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have tickets available for today?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 游客临时决定参观，确认当日余票情况

followUps.text: Yes, we still have a few tickets left for the 3 PM slot.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，下午3点的场次还剩几张票。

followUps.text: Sorry, we’re sold out for today. Would you like to book for tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，今天已经售罄。您要预订明天的票吗？

followUps.text: We have walk-in tickets available, but no guaranteed entry — it’s first come, first served.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有现场购票，但不保证入场，先到先得。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于游客在无预约情况下询问当日票务，应对不同库存状态。

subScenes.name: 选择支付方式
subScenes.description: 游客询问支持的支付方式并完成付款。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 购买门票时选择支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我刷卡支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have bills today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只带了现金。

followUps.text: Can I use WeChat Pay or Alipay? I don't have a local card.
followUps.text_cn: 可以用微信支付或支付宝吗？我没有本地银行卡。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于售票窗口、景区入口或线上取票点的现场支付场景，用户需根据自身支付工具选择回应方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: We accept cards, Apple Pay, and mobile wallets. What’s your preference?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们支持银行卡、Apple Pay和移动钱包，您偏好哪种？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 购买门票时服务人员主动提供支付选项

followUps.text: Apple Pay is fine, thanks.
followUps.text_cn: 用Apple Pay就可以，谢谢。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—do you charge a fee for using mobile payments?
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定——用移动支付会额外收费吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I’ll just use my phone to scan the QR code on the screen.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我直接扫屏幕上的二维码就行。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当服务人员明确列出支付选项时，用户可直接选择、询问费用或主动提出更具体的支付方式，体现真实互动灵活性。

qaPairs.triggerText: Payment is required now. How will you be paying?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 现在需要付款，您打算怎么支付？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 购票即将完成，催促支付的临场场景

followUps.text: I’ve got it—I’ll pay with my card right now.
followUps.text_cn: 我有，我现在就刷卡支付。

followUps.text: Wait a second—I need to check if my phone has enough battery.
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，我得看看手机还有没有电。

followUps.text: I’m sorry, I don’t have cash or card on me—can I pay later or get a ticket first?
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，我身上没现金也没卡，能先拿票再付款吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 在催促支付的紧张情境下，用户可能表现出自信、犹豫或求助，这些回应真实反映不同心理状态，适合进阶口语训练。

subScenes.name: 领取门票
subScenes.description: 游客确认购票信息并领取实体或电子票。

qaPairs.triggerText: May I have your ticket confirmation number, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请提供您的门票确认号好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 领取门票：工作人员核对预订信息

followUps.text: Sure, it's ABC123.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，是ABC123。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, I don't have it. Can you look up my name?
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我没有记录。您能用我的名字查一下吗？

followUps.text: I booked it online but haven't received the email yet.
followUps.text_cn: 我在线预订了，但还没收到邮件。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于领取门票时核对预订信息，是服务场景中最常见的第一步确认环节

qaPairs.triggerText: How many tickets are you picking up?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 领取门票：工作人员确认数量

followUps.text: Just one, for me.
followUps.text_cn: 一张，给我自己。

followUps.text: Three, please. My family is with me.
followUps.text_cn: 三张，我和家人一起来的。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I think I booked two, but let me check my phone.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我好像订了两张，让我查一下手机。

qaPairs.usageNote: 工作人员确认领取数量，用户需明确说明需求，避免出错

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you need a physical ticket or a mobile pass?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您需要纸质票还是手机电子票？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 领取门票：确认票种形式

followUps.text: I'd like a printed ticket, please.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我一张纸质票。

followUps.text: Mobile pass is fine—I'll just show it on my phone.
followUps.text_cn: 手机电子票就行，我直接在手机上出示。

followUps.text: Can I get both? I want a backup.
followUps.text_cn: 我能两种都要吗？我想留个备份。

qaPairs.usageNote: 现代票务系统常见选项，用户需明确偏好，避免现场尴尬或延误
